title: Sized local arrays array[T, N] (ROADMAP FG.7) — the private-memory sibling of shared[T,N]
loc_cap_note: Honest overage cap. r1's 800 is formally retracted as a planning failure (3.4x under the optimistic reviewer's measured ~2745 comparable subset). 2000 = optimistic-measured mirror MINUS the ~700 LOC barrier-hazard proof M3.20 provably does not build. Coder is told overage toward 2000 is expected and must be self-reported per the M3.18/M3.19 precedent, never hidden by under-testing.
core_design_summary: array[T,N] is the private-memory (Function storage) sibling of shared[T,N]: array-keyword mirror syntax, OpVariable emitted in the function entry-block prelude (like let scalars), single-index OpAccessChain read/write, N-literal-only, 4096-byte hard cap / 1024-byte spill advisory, no runtime metadata/preflight, GPU-proven local_histogram.axc. UNCHANGED from r1.

r1_to_r2_delta.r1: Asserted (unsubstantiated, false as specified) that 'a name cannot be two of these (collision rejected at registration)'. register_shared (typecheck.rs:812) knows nothing of local arrays and a mirror register_local_array would not consult shared_name_map, so shared foo + array foo would be accepted and every foo[i] would silently resolve to the local array (miscompile).
r1_to_r2_delta.r2: MANDATED bidirectional, order-independent cross-check: register_local_array MUST reject names present in shared_name_map, AND register_shared MUST be extended to reject names present in the local-array name map. Caught regardless of source order. New AT-2942 tests BOTH declaration orders (plus param/binding collision). Spec section 8.

r1_to_r2_delta.r1: Silent: an array decl inside if/for/while is hoisted to the entry prelude (SPIR-V 2.16.1) and allocated once, never reset per iteration, unlike let's per-iteration OpStore. Spec neither restricted nor documented it.
r1_to_r2_delta.r2: Nested array decls (inside any control-flow block) are a HARD HIR ERROR: HirError::LocalArrayDeclNotAtBlockScope, enforced in HIR (parser still recovers/reports-ALL). Chosen over document-hoist-once because cheaper (~10 LOC scope check, no reset codegen), least-surprise, and matches shared's de-facto top-level discipline; histogram + all use cases already declare at top level. Array is still fully usable inside loops (declared at top, indexed in loop; OpVariable persists across iterations, proven by AT-2938). New AT-2943. Spec section 5.1.

r1_to_r2_delta.r1: Spec repeatedly claimed metadata schema 'stays v3 unchanged'.
r1_to_r2_delta.r2: Corrected to v4 everywhere: CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 4 (metadata.rs:194, bumped at M3.17). Fixed in section 1 summary, section 3 semantics table, section 9 runtime note, and the literal assertions in AT-2939 and AT-2941. Substantive claim (no bump, metadata-inert) unchanged.

r1_to_r2_delta.source: reviewers DISAGREE (optimistic ~2745 measured vs pessimistic ~700 credible)
r1_to_r2_delta.r2: Resolved with numbers in section 12. Optimistic measured the comparable M3.2 subset at ~2745 LOC (3.4x r1's 800 cap). Pessimistic's ~700 counted only the two new modules (shared.rs hir 191 + codegen 223 = 414, verified by wc -l) + small deltas, undercounting the typecheck/validate/body/emit dispatch-site deltas and the 18-AT test code. Reconciliation: 2745 comparable MINUS ~700 barrier-hazard proof M3.20 sheds = ~2045 (the cap, 2000). Target 1600 = further trim for genuine reuse (presence-only write-set BTreeMap<u32,()> vs shared's Vec<HirExprKind>; no aggregate-preflight; copy-rename of proven modules). Itemized table: lexer token.rs ~30, parser ~200, hir local.rs ~200, expr ~40, typecheck ~260, validate ~150, lower ~20, codegen local.rs ~230, body+emit prelude+accesschain ~140, example ~35 (source subtotal ~1305) + 18 ATs ~500 = ~1805 worst-case. Both reviewers' evidence consistent at target 1600 / cap 2000.

AT-2940 extended from the 5-kernel set to the ENTIRE examples/ corpus (a new hard lexer keyword can perturb ANY source). Safe by construction: verified array appears in existing .axc ONLY inside // comments (matmul_shared_coopmat.axc:32-33, flash_attention.axc:46, matmul_rb_coopmat.axc:14, et al.), which the lexer strips before tokenizing.

Corrected to crates/axc-lexer/src/token.rs (TokenKind::Array variant, keyword_from_str ~line 256, reserved deny-list match ~line 326, exhaustive TokenKind matches). lib.rs only re-exports. Fixed in section 12 and files_to_modify below.

Added HirError::LocalArrayConstIndexOutOfBounds: a constant literal index >= N is decidable and zero-false-positive, so it is a HARD ERROR (not warning). Dynamic/symbolic indices stay UB-by-design and documented. ~10 LOC. New AT-2944. Spec section 5.2.

Section 5 now honestly discloses the write-before-read advisory is a source-order presence set (path-insensitive): zero false-positive but MISSES true positives (a write inside an if or a zero-trip loop populates the write-set unconditionally, so an else-path or post-loop read is not flagged). Same conservatism as shared's SET-based barrier analysis; uninitialized-read stays UB-by-design on any path.

Section 15 acknowledges that once array is a hard keyword it can no longer be an @optimization_log RecordField key (key parser at parser.rs:735 accepts only Ident + special-cased Kernel). No existing schema field is named array (golden-identity holds); disclosed as a namespace narrowing. Also reframed the M3.12 citation as a register-pressure analogy (M3.12 did not measure array byte-size-vs-occupancy) per optimistic minor.

verified_facts_r2: token.rs is the lexer keyword file (keyword_from_str at line 256 has "shared" => Shared; reserved match at line 326); lib.rs only re-exports (confirmed).

array appears in examples/*.axc ONLY inside // comments (grep confirmed: matmul_shared_coopmat.axc:32-33, flash_attention.axc:46, matmul_rb_coopmat.axc:14, matmul_msg_coopmat.axc:62, q4km_matmul_rb_coopmat_f32acc_db.axc:102) -- golden-identity safe.
outstanding_open_questions: Register-file / local-memory spill thresholds (1024 advisory / 4096 hard cap) are static heuristics; device register budget is not portably queryable in Vulkan. Acceptable now; revisit if EB.1 hardware data suggests a per-vendor tuning.
handoff_notes_for_coder: Insert the array OpVariable loop INSIDE the body.rs entry-block prelude loop (after the BindingTy::Scalar loop, before precondition checks / body statements) so the var_after_non_var assertion (body.rs:2532) holds even when let-scalars and arrays coexist. This is the ONLY legal place for a Function-storage OpVariable.
register_shared MUST be extended (not just mirrored) to cross-check the local-array name map -- this is the #1 blocker fix; do not skip the register_shared side.
Nested-decl rejection is enforced in HIR, not the parser (parser still recovers and reports ALL other errors in the same pass).
Overage toward the 2000 cap is expected and must be self-reported per the M3.18/M3.19 precedent -- do not under-test to hit a number.
